drought.description: The ship's old television flashes red: SOIL MOISTURE DECLINING. Nyxen reads it calmly.

lines.text: Nyxen: Commander, the soil is drying out.

drought.description: Zorvax throws his arms wide in delight.

lines.text: Zorvax: Wonderful! Prepare the human welcome baskets!

drought.description: Cadet B raises a hand with a question.

lines.text: Cadet B: How many humans are coming?

drought.description: Cadet B looks up at the ceiling hatch, worried.

lines.text: Cadet B: So… how many baskets?

drought.description: Zorvax gestures grandly. A mountain of welcome baskets tumbles from the ceiling and buries Cadet B up to the cap.
